# apprentice

apprentice lets a coding agent or a hosted model use macOS, Linux and the web for you the way a careful person would: it reads the screen as text, uses the real cursor and keyboard at human pace, and proposes every change for approval.

Install:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/robertsolves/apprentice.git ~/.apprentice/src && ~/.apprentice/src/install.sh
```

It needs macOS 14 or later and Swift (Xcode or the command-line tools). Then just ask your agent to do things on your Mac, in a Linux VM, or on the web. Questions reach you in a small window on the Mac, or on your phone once `apprentice phone` is set up.

- [Website](https://robertsolves.github.io/apprentice/): overview and install
- [GitHub](https://github.com/robertsolves/apprentice): source and install
- [Issues](https://github.com/robertsolves/apprentice/issues)
